arXiv:2608.27391v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 8 月 27 日arXiv:2608.27391v1 [cs.AI] 27 Aug 2026

CorporateBench：大规模问答基准测试CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking
具有时态知识库with Temporal Knowledge Bases

Sil Hamilton ††thanks: Correspondence to: srh255@cornell.edu Affiliation:  Epiq AI Labs Affiliation:  Cornell University    Albert Yu Sun Affiliation:  Epiq AI Labs    Oscar J. Romero Affiliation:  Epiq AI Labs    Carl-Leander Henneking Affiliation:  Epiq AI Labs    David Mimno Affiliation:  Cornell University    Bishan Yang, Igor Labutov Affiliation:  Epiq AI Labs
摘要Abstract

法学硕士越来越能够回答有关企业规模文档集合的复杂问题。 但评估很困难：公司不想共享内部通信，而且合成数据集过于简单。 我们呈现LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don’t want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present企业长凳CorporateBench (CB），一个经过人工验证的多任务问答基准，其规模接近法学硕士在企业通信网络中遇到的条件，评估语料库超过 230,000 个文档。), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents.CB通过四个综合生成的公司（员工人数从 12 人到 10,000 人）从两个维度（信息提取和知识库查询）评估法学硕士。 每个语料库都是从描述一致世界的随时间变化的知识库中采样的，即使在数十万个文档中也能保证跨文档逻辑一致性。 我们评估五个法学硕士evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs onCB，随着输入大小接近实际规模，表现出越来越差的性能。, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales.CB为法学硕士开发人员提供了企业沟通推理的衡量标准，填补了基准测试生态系统中的一个关键空白。provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

1 简介Introduction

像公司这样的复杂组织通过员工的沟通和合作产生大量的内部文档。 法学硕士对于知识工作、文档分析和其他需要对组织及其社交网络进行一般推理的任务越来越有帮助Complex organizations like corporations produce massive quantities of internal documents through employees communicating and working together. LLMs are increasingly helpful for knowledge work, document analysis, and other tasks requiring general reasoning about organizations and their social networks(Raza et al., 2025; Brachman et al., 2025)。 但是，尽管在扩展大型语言模型 (LLM) 上下文窗口方面取得了重大进展. But despite significant advances in extending large language model (LLM) context windows(Huang et al., 2024; Beltagy et al., 2020)，最先进的法学硕士继续努力应对企业场景中经常需要的许多文档的复杂推理, state-of-the-art LLMs continue to struggle with complex reasoning over many documents as regularly required in enterprise scenarios(Liu et al., 2024; Hsieh et al., 2024)。 这一缺陷阻碍了法学硕士在行业中的广泛采用，但当前的评估指标未能捕捉到这种失败模式。. This deficiency hinders wide-scale LLM adoption in industry, but current evaluation metrics fail to capture this failure mode.

常见的长上下文理解测试无法重现真实企业环境的复杂性和相互关联性。 综合基准Common long context understanding tests do not reproduce the complexity and interconnectedness of real corporate environments. Synthetic benchmarks(Kamradt, 2023)过于简化，而由于保密协议，基于现实企业数据的更现实的基准很少are excessively simplified, while more realistic benchmarks based on real-world enterprise data are scarce due to non-disclosure agreements(Zhang et al., 2024)。 此外，由于规模和现实性的限制，现有的少数企业基准无法充分再现企业状况。 企业语料库可以扩展到数百万个文档，这使得从头开始生成整个语料库的成本成为设计基准时的主要考虑因素。. The few existing enterprise benchmarks moreover fail to adequately reproduce corporate conditions due to limitations in scale and realism. Enterprise corpora can scale to millions of documents, making the cost of generating a whole corpus from scratch a major concern when designing benchmarks.

为了解决这些限制，我们引入To address these limitations, we introduce企业长凳CorporateBench，一个企业基准，包含大型且内部一致的企业通信网络，具有可验证的基本事实，如图所示, an enterprise benchmark containing large and internally consistent corporate communication networks with verifiable ground truth as shown inFigure 2.11 1我们发布数据和代码于We release data and code athttps://huggingface.co/datasets/epiq-ai-labs/corporatebench. 企业长凳CorporateBench首先对结构进行采样，然后从程序生成的知识库 (KB) 中生成文档，以捕获员工、团队、项目和任务之间随时间变化的复杂关系，从而弥合合成与真实之间的差距。 这些知识库是我们生成现实规模的多元化企业语料库的基础。我们的主要贡献如下：bridges the synthetic-real gap by first sampling structures, and then documents, from procedurally generated knowledge bases (KBs) that capture complex relationships between employees, teams, projects, and tasks over time. These KBs serve as our foundation for generating diverse corporate corpora at realistic scales. Our primary contributions are as follows:

  • •

    全面的公司模拟。Comprehensive company simulation.我们采用知识库到语料库的生成来生成紧密模仿现实世界的企业文档集合，保留跨团队和部门的时间顺序和尊重角色的沟通方向。We adapt KB-to-corpus generation to produce corporate document collections closely mimicking the real world, preserving temporal sequencing and role-respecting communication directions across teams and departments.

  • •

    紧密关联的证据集。Deeply interconnected evidence sets.我们构建了一个大规模基准，其中回答典型查询需要集成多个文档中的证据，强调对总大小可能超过上下文窗口的企业级通信集进行多文档检索和推理。We construct a large-scale benchmark in which answering typical queries requires integrating evidence across many documents, stressing multi-document retrieval and reasoning over enterprise-scale communication sets whose total size can exceed context windows.

  • •

    企业规模的任务。Enterprise-scale tasks.我们提供了一个任务套件，其中包含直接从知识库计算出的确定性标签，从而实现可重复的评估。这种基于知识库的设计旨在缩小模型的扩展上下文窗口与企业环境中真正的长上下文理解之间的差距。We provide a task suite with deterministic labels directly computed from the KB, enabling reproducible evaluation. This KB-grounded design targets the gap between models’ extended context windows and genuine long context understanding in enterprise settings.

2 相关工作Related Work

在长期背景下对法学硕士进行基准测试。Benchmarking LLMs in long contexts.

企业数据集本质上是长上下文。 当代法学硕士现在可以处理数百万个代币Enterprise datasets are naturally long context. Contemporary LLMs can now attend to millions of tokens(OpenAI et al., 2024; Grattafiori et al., 2024; Team Gemini et al., 2024)，但这些模型的长上下文理解能力较差, but these models suffer from poor long context understanding(Kaplan et al., 2020; Liu et al., 2024)。 识别这些故障模式的一种方法是“大海捞针”测试及其衍生方法. One method for identifying these failure modes is the “needle-in-a-haystack” test and its descendants(Kamradt, 2023; Vodrahalli et al., 2024; OpenAI, 2025)，但这些综合基准以现实性换取生成速度，从而导致更新的基准测试模型在书籍和电影脚本等文档上的出现, but these synthetic benchmarks trade realism for generation speed, leading to newer benchmarks testing models over documents like books and movie scripts(Kočiský et al., 2018; An et al., 2023; Karpinska et al., 2024; Hamilton et al., 2025)数量有限，达不到企业规模。 寻求解决方案的研究人员引入了基于财务记录的企业基准whose limited number fail to qualify as enterprise scale. Researchers seeking solutions have introduced enterprise benchmarks based on financial records(Deußer et al., 2022; Xie et al., 2024; Xu et al., 2024), 合法的, legal(Manor and Li, 2019; Guha et al., 2023; Fei et al., 2023; Ryan et al., 2025), 知识工作, knowledge work(Boisvert et al., 2024; Drouin et al., 2024; Styles et al., 2024; Yao et al., 2024; Xu et al., 2025)，以及其他一般公司任务, and other general corporate tasks(Jiang et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025)。 这些基准受到低质量数据源的影响，通常会转换非公司数据以避免违反保密协议。 另一种方法是通过法学硕士模拟知识工作来生成多样化的综合企业语料库. These benchmarks suffer from low quality data sources, typically transforming non-corporate data to avoid violating non-disclosure agreements. An alternative approach involves generating diverse synthetic enterprise corpora with LLMs emulating knowledge work(Choubey et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2025; Vishwakarma et al., 2025)，但现有的实现规模较小（约, but existing implementations suffer from small scale (ca.≤\leq30,000 个文档）和有问题的基本事实，因为数据集是通过提示 LLM 创建的，并且没有单一方法可以保证 LLM 输出将匹配所有所需的特征。 因此，匹配真实的企业规模需要新一代的方法。30,000 documents) and problematic ground truth because datasets are created via prompting LLMs and there is no single method for guaranteeing LLM output will match all desired characteristics. Matching real corporate scale therefore demands new generation methods.

综合知识库。Synthetic knowledge bases.

由于企业环境在结构上是自相似的（例如，员工存在于组织的各个级别），因此可以方便地在知识库中描述它们。 知识库长期以来一直被用来表示人类知识Because enterprise environments are structurally self-similar (e.g. employees exist at all levels of an organization), they can be conveniently described in a knowledge base. KBs have long been used to represent human knowledge(Bollacker et al., 2008; Talmor and Berant, 2018)，以及最近用于生成接地综合文档, and more recently for producing grounded synthetic documents(Agarwal et al., 2021)，但由于从非结构化文本中解析关系的困难，像企业环境这样的复杂系统在早期研究中很少被描述, but complex systems like enterprise environments were rarely profiled in early studies due to difficulties with parsing relations from unstructured text(Kwiatkowski et al., 2013; Yang et al., 2015; Yang and Mitchell, 2019)。 此后，法学硕士已被证明擅长这项任务. LLMs have since proven adept at this task(Labutov et al., 2019b; Sun et al., 2023; Machado et al., 2024; Sahay et al., 2025; Gong et al., 2025)同样将文本转换为结构化查询and likewise converting text to structured queries(Labutov et al., 2019a; Trivedi et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2023; Sun et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2025)。 我们希望知识库能够提供一个单一的、任意详细的世界状态，从中我们可以 (i) 合成真实的、百万级大小的文档集合，以及 (ii) 通过查询底层图来得出准确的基本事实。. We look to KBs to provide a single, arbitrarily detailed world state from which we can (i) synthesize document collections at realistic, million-scale sizes and (ii) derive exact ground truth by querying the underlying graph.

3 数据集构建Dataset Construction

我们开始通过建立基本事实来构建我们的综合企业基准。 在本节中，我们描述一个语料库构建管道，其输出具有两个属性：We begin constructing our synthetic enterprise benchmark by establishing ground truth. In this section we describe a corpus construction pipeline whose output enjoys two properties:

  • •

    任意尺度。Arbitrary scale.对于任何所需的语料库大小For any desired corpus sizenn，管道可以生成, the pipeline can generate≥n\geq n文档，同时在所有生成的文档中保持一致的质量，随着 LLM 上下文窗口的增长保持未来的相关性。documents while maintaining consistent quality across all generated documents, maintaining future relevance as LLM context windows grow.

  • •

    逻辑一致性。Logical consistency. ∀d∈C\forall d\in C，文档中没有声明, no statement in documentdd与我们的地面实况知识库中确立的任何事实相矛盾。contradicts any fact established in our ground truth knowledge base.

我们首先生成一个代表公司世界的知识库We first generate a knowledge base representing the world of a companyCC，将所有实体及其属性和关系编码在一起。 然后，我们生成电子邮件，证实知识库中的组织关系、任务和项目进度，通过插入揭示关系的“证据”字符串来强制一致性。 该管道满足逻辑一致性，因为在理想情况下，可以根据从中采样的所有文档来重建图形，并且由于文档是模板化的，所以可以任意缩放。, encoding all entities together with their properties and relationships. We then generate emails that substantiate organizational relationships, tasks, and project progress from the KB, enforcing consistency by inserting “evidence” strings revealing relationships. This pipeline satisfies logical consistency because under ideal circumstances the graph can be reconstructed from all documents sampled from it, and arbitrary scale because documents are templated.

3.1 定义知识库Defining the Knowledge Base

我们从一个正式的本体开始，捕获我们公司所需的语义，用简洁的 RDF 三重语言（Turtle；We begin with a formal ontology capturing the desired semantics of our companies, written in Terse RDF Triple Language (Turtle;Beckett et al. 2014）。 我们正式定义一家公司). We formally define a companyC=(D,T,E)C=(D,T,E)作为全体员工的工会as the union of all employeesEE由团队组织organized by teamsTT和部门and departmentsDD，其中每个团队严格属于一个部门，所有员工严格属于一个团队，部门领导和高管除外。 使用 OWL 解析器序列化我们的公司可以保证一致性。, where each team strictly belongs to one department and all employees strictly belong to one team, barring department leads and executives. Serializing our companies with an OWL parser guarantees consistency.

我们的本体定义了两个基类，Our ontology defines two base classes,实体Entity和and关系Relationship，作为知识库中的节点和边。 我们将这些扩展到组织实体（公司、部门、团队、员工）和工作事项（项目、会议、任务），并通过七个关系谓词链接：, serving as nodes and edges in the knowledge base. We extend these with organizational entities (companies, departments, teams, employees) and work matter (projects, meetings, tasks), linked by seven relationship predicates:成员MemberOf, 报告对象ReportsTo, 工作上WorksOn, 工作地点WorksAt, 出席Attends, 整理Organize, 和, and属于BelongsTo。 这些将员工沿着三个轴联系在一起：组织（成员资格和报告层次结构）、工作方面（任务分配）和沟通（会议出席和组织）。. These tie together employees along three axes: organizational (membership and reporting hierarchies), work-wise (task assignments), and communication (meeting attendance and organization).

3.2 发电公司Generating Companies

为了生成公司知识库，我们根据公司类型和所需员工数量运行以下程序：To generate company knowledge bases, we run the following procedure conditioned on the type of company and desired number of employees:

1. 产生公司层次结构。Produce company hierarchy.

我们根据所需员工数量对部门和团队数量进行对数调整，目标是平均团队人数为 5-10 人，部门人数为 8-68 人。We logarithmically scale department and team counts with the desired employee count, targeting an average team headcount of 5–10 and department headcount of 8–68 when scaling from10110^{1} to 10410^{4}员工。employees.22 2我们从现实世界的分布中选择这些值。We select these values from real-world distributions.最高管理层的高管人数从 1 人增加到 13 人；部门和团队配备一名或多名经理。 我们将所有实体与C-suite scales from 1 to 13 executives; departments and teams are equipped with one or more managers. We link all entities with报告对象ReportsTo和and成员MemberOf关系并验证层次结构形成一棵没有孤立节点的有效树。relationships and verify the hierarchy forms a valid tree with no orphan nodes.

2. 模拟一段时间内的工作。Simulate work over time.

我们在一个季度或 90 天的时间内对公司进行模拟。 每天，我们随机为每位员工分配一项任务We simulate the company over the course of one quarter, or 90 days. For each day, we randomly assign each employee a task withP=1/45P=1/45以便每个员工在季度末完成 1 到 3 项任务。such that each employee completes between 1 to 3 tasks by the end of the quarter.33 3更现实的工作量是让员工每天完成 1 到 3 项任务。我们有意限制该值以确保统一的关系计数（参见A more realistic workload would have employees complete 1 to 3 tasks a day. We purposefully limit this value to ensure uniform relationship counts (cf.Table 1).我们跟踪任务分配和完成日期。 我们验证所有任务分配都在模拟季度内，并且没有员工超过 1 到 3 项任务的目标。We track task assignment and completion dates. We verify that all task assignments fall within the simulated quarter and that no employee exceeds the target of 1 to 3 tasks.

3. 随着时间的推移模拟会议。Simulate meetings over time.

我们模拟所有六种会议类型的员工会议：直接报告、团队会议、任务协作会议、高管会议、项目审查和部门会议。 会议生成过程会考虑员工角色、报告结构、团队成员资格和项目分配，以确定适当的会议时间表。We simulate meetings for employees across all six meeting types: direct reports, team meetings, task collaboration sessions, executive meetings, project reviews, and department meetings. The meeting generation process considers employee roles, reporting structures, team memberships, and project assignments to determine appropriate meeting schedules.Appendix D包括有关会议的更多详细信息。 我们确认所有生成的会议都遵守角色限制，例如直接报告会议仅将员工与经理配对。includes more details on meetings. We confirm all generated meetings respect role constraints, e.g. that direct report meetings only pair employees with their managers.

4. 更新公司层次结构。Update company hierarchy.

在季度末，我们通过雇用额外的人员来更新公司层次结构At the end of the quarter we update the company hierarchy by hiring an additional≈\approx将 10% 的员工随机分配到不同的团队中。 这个过程必然会迫使这些团队分裂，以维持所有团队所需的平均人数，从而产生额外的人员。10% employees into a random assortment of teams. This process necessarily forces the splitting of those teams to maintain the desired average headcount across all teams, producing additional成员MemberOf关系。 此过程确保并非所有relationships. This process ensures that not all成员MemberOf关系在季度末有效，因此在取样证据时需要至少两份文件才能充分“揭示”就业状况。 我们验证新员工是否与新员工正确关联relationships are valid at the end of the quarter, thus requiring at least two documents to fully “reveal” employment status when sampling evidence. We verify that new hires are correctly linked with fresh成员MemberOf和and报告对象ReportsTo关系，并且之前的关系标有适当的结束日期。relationships and that prior relationships are marked with appropriate end dates.

5. 注释所有实体。Annotate all entities.

此时的公司层次结构包含许多实体，但没有语义属性，例如名称或标题。 我们为每家公司准备了一段“故事”The company hierarchy at this point contains many entities, but no semantic properties such as names or titles. We prepare a one-paragraph “story” for each company inFigure 2包含公司起源、座右铭、重点、行业等详细信息。containing details such as company origin, motto, focus, industry, etc.44 4我们提供所有故事We provide all stories inAppendix A.然后，我们将每个实体从层次结构顶部开始递归传递到底部到 Claude Haiku 4.5，提示它根据每个实体的类型和大小生成一组适当的属性。 我们最终为员工和项目制作了别名，以实现多样性。 我们手动检查带注释的实体样本，以确认属性在上下文中是否合适。We then recursively pass each entity beginning at the top of the hierarchy down to the bottom to Claude Haiku 4.5 prompting it to produce a set of appropriate properties for each entity given its type and size. We finally produce aliases for employees and projects for diversity. We manually inspect a sample of annotated entities to confirm properties are contextually appropriate.

6. 产生三倍。Produce triples.

我们从完整的电子邮件中随机抽取 100 封电子邮件We sample 100 random emails from the full企业长凳CorporateBench用于人类验证的语料库。 因为每个文档都肯定地断言了一种关系（例如，一个人管理另一个人），所以我们提示 Claude Sonnet 4 通过修改证据字符串来反转每个文档以否定关系。 这会产生正面和负面示例的平衡测试集。 我们将 10 组（每组 5 名非专家审阅者）与每批 20 个文档配对，要求他们判断每个文档是否在二进制尺度上积极断言了这种关系。 在所有 1,000 项判断中，审阅者正确识别预期关系的率为 76.2%。corpus for human validation. Because each document positively asserts a relationship (e.g. that one person manages another), we prompt Claude Sonnet 4 to invert each document by modifying the evidence string to negate the relationship. This yields a balanced test set of positive and negative examples. We pair ten groups of five non-expert reviewers with batches of 20 documents each, asking them to judge whether each document positively asserts the relationship on a binary scale. Across all 1,000 judgements, reviewers correctly identify the intended relationship 76.2% of the time.

5 任务Tasks

企业长凳CorporateBench测试分为两类的五项任务的模型：提取和质量保证。两者评估不同的能力。提取评估模型是否可以tests models on five tasks organized in two categories: extraction and QA. The two assess distinct capabilities. Extraction assesses whether a model can构建constructQA 评估时来自原始文档的结构化知识库a structured knowledge base from raw documents while QA evaluates推理reasoning在已经构建的表示上。模型可能会正确回答知识库 QA 问题，但一开始就无法构建知识库。over an already-constructed representation. A model may answer KB QA questions correctly yet fail to build the KB in the first place.

We then apply deduplication techniques like exact name match and email-based clustering to reduce redundancy. 5.2 质量保证任务QA Tasks

我们的三项 QA 任务评估有关公司及其文件的事实问题的模型。 QA 问题是从 250 个手动编写的问题模板生成的，这些模板在公司和任务中实例化，并带有占位符变量（例如员工或任务），这些占位符变量通过经过验证的 SPARQL 查询（因此不是通过 LLM 生成）动态填充 KB 中的值。 通过构造，更复杂的问题需要跨知识图中的更多节点收集信息，从而跨更多文档收集信息。 QA 问题有五种答案类型：字符串、日期、整数、布尔值和字符串集。 除集合之外的所有类型都根据精确匹配进行判断（如果匹配则为 1，如果不匹配则为 0），但我们计算Our three QA tasks evaluate models on factual questions about the company and its documents. QA questions are generated from 250 manually written question templates instantiated across companies and tasks with placeholder variables (e.g., employee or task) that are filled dynamically with values from the KB via verified SPARQL queries (and thus not by LLM generation). By construction, more complex questions require gathering information across more nodes in the knowledge graph and thus across more documents. QA questions come in five answer types: string, date, integer, boolean, and sets of strings. All types, except for sets, are judged on exact match (1 if match, 0 if not), but we calculateF1F_{1}对于允许模型部分学分的集合。 我们比较两种 QA 设置中的模型。 第一个是for sets to allow models partial credit. We compare models in two QA settings. The first isRAG (Lewis et al., 2021)。 我们为模型配备了基于 RAG 的搜索工具，其中包含所有文档。. We equip models with a RAG-based search tool containing all the documents.99 9使用UsingPG向量pgvector和and文本嵌入-3-小text-embedding-3-small.此设置在现实的企业环境中建立绩效。 下一个设置是This setting establishes performance in realistic corporate settings. The next setting isKB，我们为模型配备了 SQL 工具，用于查询通过我们的 ETL 管道直接从地面实况知识库文件导入的数据。, where we equip models with a SQL tool for querying data directly imported with our ETL pipeline from our ground truth KB file.1010 10我们描述了管道We describe the pipeline inAppendix E.此设置确定了模型性能的上限This setting establishes an upper bound on model performance相对于 RAG 设置relative to the RAG setting，因为模型可以直接访问结构化的地面事实，而不是从嘈杂的文档中检索。 我们注意到，文本到 SQL 本身仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，并且这些分数并不代表绝对的性能上限。 任务如下：, since models receive direct access to structured ground truth rather than retrieving from noisy documents. We note that text-to-SQL remains a challenging task in its own right, and that these scores do not represent an absolute performance ceiling. The tasks are as follows:

知识库质量保证。KB QA.

此任务涉及回答有关实体、关系以及这些关系的暂时性的问题。 中的示例问题This task involves answering questions about entities, relationships, and the temporality of these relationships. The example question inTable 2需要从电子邮件中识别员工，requires identifying employees from emails,和and根据入职文件进行时间推理来确定员工何时加入。temporal reasoning to identify when employees joined based on onboarding documents.

此任务涉及回答有关电子邮件中涵盖的文档主题的问题。 主题 QA 示例This task involves answering questions about the topics of the documents that are covered in emails. The Topic QA example inTable 2要求模型在特定时间间隔内阅读员工的电子邮件，并回答员工是否讨论过该主题。requires models to read the employee’s emails during a specific interval of time and answer whether the employee discussed that topic.

综合质量保证。Integrated QA.

6 结果Results

我们评估了五种当代模型We evaluate five contemporary models on企业长凳CorporateBench提供对当前技术水平的了解。 这些型号是：Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-5 Nano、GPT-5.1 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite。 我们特别选择“更轻”的模型来在性能和成本之间取得平衡，因为在完整的 263,466 个文档集上评估了一个模型。to provide a sense of the current state of the art. These models are: Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5 Nano, GPT-5.1, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite. We specifically select “lighter” models to strike a balance between performance and cost given evaluating a model on the full 263,466 document set inCB可能会产生大量 API 成本。 我们提供了评估指标的完整概要can incur significant API costs. We provide a full run-down of our evaluation metrics inAppendix K.

6.2 质量保证任务QA Tasks

我们报告所有 QA 绩效We report all QA performance inTable 4。与 RAG 相比，直接 KB 访问的模型始终表现得更好。 我们的设计将每个公司每项任务的问题数量固定为 250 个（. Models consistently perform better with direct KB access than with RAG. Our design holds the number of questions constant at 250 per company per task (Appendix K）同时增加语料库大小，因此较大的公司会按比例为每个问题提供更多文档（) while increasing corpus size, so larger companies present proportionally more documents per question (≈\approx1.4 至1.4 to≈\approx931）。 在所有三种 QA 类型中，最佳 KB 分数超过了相应的最佳 RAG 分数，并且这种差距随着规模的扩大而扩大：在 KB QA 上，KB-RAG 差异从 0.24 (S) 增加到 0.37 (XL)。 这表明 RAG 可能足以满足较小的语料库，但规模在呈现知识时会导致问题。931). Across all three QA types, the best KB scores exceed the corresponding best RAG scores, and this gap widens with scale: on KB QA, the KB–RAG difference increases from 0.24 (S) to 0.37 (XL). This suggests RAG may suffice for smaller corpora, but scale causes problems when surfacing knowledge.

KB QA 和主题 QA 的性能会随着语料库大小的变化而降低，这反映出在较大集合中定位精确信息的难度。 集成 QA 表现出不同的模式：两种方法的性能随着规模的扩大而略有提高，可能是因为更大的语料库为综合提供了更丰富的跨源上下文。Performance degrades with corpus size for KB QA and Topic QA, reflecting the difficulty of locating precise information in larger collections. Integrated QA exhibits a different pattern: performance slightly improves with scale for both methods, likely because larger corpora provide richer cross-source context for synthesis.

最后，我们注意到模型级别的差异：两种 GPT-5 模型均优于其他 RAG 模型，而 Claude Sonnet 4.5 则在 KB 查询方面表现出色。 然而，GPT-5.1 表现出一个早期停止问题，该问题对 KB 设置产生不成比例的影响（出现 191 次，而 RAG 出现 56 次），部分解释了方法之间的性能差距。We finally note model-level differences: both GPT-5 models outperform others with RAG, while Claude Sonnet 4.5 excels at KB querying. However, GPT-5.1 exhibits an early stopping problem that disproportionately affects the KB setting (191 occurrences vs. 56 with RAG), partially explaining the performance gap between methods.1212 12具体来说，模型在收到工具响应后返回空字符串，而不是生成答案。Specifically, the model returns empty string after receiving a tool response instead of generating an answer.

7 结论Conclusion

我们发布We release企业长凳CorporateBench，用于测试法学硕士在企业特定检索和推理任务上的基准。, a benchmark for testing LLMs on enterprise-specific retrieval and reasoning tasks.CB共有 263,466 个合成文档，这些文档是从代表不同规模公司的四个程序生成的知识库中采样的。 这种新颖的生成过程允许features 263,466 total synthetic documents sampled from four procedurally generated knowledge bases representing companies of varying scale. This novel generation process allowsCB为了在任意规模的语料库上生成实际任务，同时保持文档间逻辑一致性，这是前身企业基准所缺乏的质量。 对 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 最近的五位法学硕士的测试表明，当代法学硕士在完成企业任务方面的能力微乎其微，随着语料库规模的扩大和规模的扩大，性能呈反比下降to produce realistic tasks over corpora of arbitrary scale while maintaining inter-document logical consistency, a quality predecessor enterprise benchmarks lacked. Testing five recent LLMs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google indicates contemporary LLMs are marginally competent at completing enterprise tasks, with performance decreasing inversely with corpora scale up to and beyond10510^{5}文件。 我们的方法、基准和结果对于有兴趣评估部署在企业环境中的法学硕士绩效的研究人员和行业从业者来说很有价值。documents. Our methods, benchmark, and results are of value to researchers and industry practitioners interested in assessing LLM performance when deployed in corporate environments.

下一步。Next steps.

我们鼓励未来的研究人员继续缩小综合基准与现实基准之间的差距。 其他领域（例如深度研究）的研究人员将希望评估复制我们对程序生成的知识库的使用是否会同样富有成效。We encourage future researchers to continue closing the gap between synthetic and realistic benchmarks. Researchers working in other domains (e.g. deep research) will want to evaluate whether replicating our use of procedurally generated KBs will be similarly fruitful.

局限性Limitations

我们承认以下限制：We acknowledge the following limitations:

范围仅限于通信网络。Scope limited to communication networks.

企业长凳CorporateBench重点关注电子邮件，它仍然是企业通信网络中的主导文档类型：安然语料库是最大的公开企业数据集，几乎完全由电子邮件组成focuses on email, which remains the dominant document type in corporate communication networks: the Enron corpus, the largest publicly available corporate dataset, is composed almost entirely of email(Klimt and Yang, 2004)。 真实的企业环境还涉及 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams 等沟通渠道，以及技术规范、财务报告和演示文稿等文档类型，每种类型都具有独特的结构特征。 延伸. Real corporate settings additionally involve communication channels such as Slack and Microsoft Teams, and document types such as technical specifications, financial reports, and presentations, each with distinct structural characteristics. Extending企业长凳CorporateBench建立更多的沟通渠道是未来工作的方向。to additional communication channels is a direction for future work.

简化的文档类型。Simplified document types.

我们的基准测试主要关注电子邮件通信。 真实的企业环境涉及较新的沟通渠道，例如 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams，并且文档本身可能因文档类型而异，例如技术规范、财务报告、电子表格、演示文稿。 每种文档类型都有独特的结构特征，可能会给法学硕士带来除电子邮件之外的不同挑战。 我们注意到，在最近的企业发现环境中，电子邮件仍然是绝大多数文档类型Our benchmark focuses primarily on email communications. Real corporate settings involve newer communication channels such as Slack and Microsoft Teams, and documents themselves may be diverse across document types such as technical specifications, financial reports, spreadsheets, presentations. Each document type has distinct structural characteristics that may present different challenges for LLMs beyond just emails. We note that emails still remain a large majority document type in recent corporate discovery contexts(Gallivan, 2024).

时间动力学和演化。Temporal dynamics and evolution.

在模拟四分之一的公司活动时，我们明确不会对长期组织演变进行建模，例如战略支点、并购、文化转变或多年来制度知识的逐渐积累。 我们将其留给未来的工作，以超越 90 天的模拟窗口，以揭示更长期的现象。In simulating one quarter of company activity, we explicitly do not model longer-term organizational evolution such as strategic pivots, mergers and acquisitions, cultural shifts, or the gradual accumulation of institutional knowledge over years. We leave it for future work to expand beyond the 90-day simulation window to surface longer term phenomena.

LLM 生成的工件。LLM-generated artifacts.

尽管努力通过主题、个性和正式程度来确保多样性，但这些文档是由 Claude Haiku 4.5 生成的，这可能会在写作风格、词汇和文档结构方面引入系统偏差或伪影。 根据此基准评估的模型在人工编写的公司文档上的表现可能会有所不同。 我们将我们的任务视为难度的“下限”，LLM 代理需要能够首先解决我们的任务，然后再解决可能更混乱、更困难、更复杂的人类编写的语料库。Despite efforts to ensure diversity through topics, personalities, and formality levels, the documents are generated by Claude Haiku 4.5, which may introduce systematic biases or artifacts in writing style, vocabulary, and document structure. Models evaluated on this benchmark may perform differently on human-written corporate documents. We see our tasks as a “lower bound” in terms of difficulty, where LLM agents need to be able to solve our tasks first before solving likely messier, more difficult, and more complex human-written corpora.

质量检查数据集。QA datasets.

有一些假设和/或设计决策会影响 QA 数据集。这些内容提供给读者There are a few assumptions and/or design decisions that affect the QA datasets. These are offered to the reader inAppendix J.

道德考虑Ethical Considerations

所有合成材料All synthetically generated materials in企业长凳CorporateBench是通过 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 提供的 API 端点生成的，并启用了内容过滤。 我们注意到，LLM 开发人员经常在训练期间使用基准作为参考点，这种做法可能会导致基准特定的特质，并且可能会不成比例地强调模型输出中的某些语义和/或句法质量。 因此，我们通过预先计算名称来促进我们生成的公司的民族和种族多样性were generated via OpenAI and Anthropic-provided API endpoints with content filtering enabled. We note LLM developers often use benchmarks as a reference point during training, and that this practice can lead to benchmark-specific idiosyncrasies and can disproportionately emphasize certain semantic and/or syntactic qualities in model output. We therefore promoted ethnic and racial diversity in our generated companies by pre-computing names withFaker，一个用于按程序生成姓名和电子邮件等个人信息的 Python 库。 我们启用所有基于拉丁字母的 Faker 列表，确保所有四家公司的人类样本公平且多样化。, a Python library for procedurally generating personal information like names and emails. We enable all Latin alphabet-based Faker lists, ensuring a fair and diverse sample of humans across all four companies.

附录BAppendix B证据串Evidence Strings

非会议证据字符串。Non-meeting evidence strings.

这些字符串通过明确性和时间阶段不同的语言模式证实了电子邮件发件人与实体（团队、经理、任务或公司）之间的关系。These strings substantiate relationships between email senders and entities (teams, managers, tasks, or companies) through linguistic patterns that vary in explicitness and temporal stage.

每种关系类型都包含按时间阶段（开始、正在进行、结束）和证据强度（显式、隐式）组织的证据字符串。 显式字符串使用明确的关系动词直接陈述关系，而隐式字符串则通过动作、协调或所有格语言表现出积极的参与。Each relationship type contains evidence strings organized by temporal stage (start, ongoing, end) and evidence strength (explicit, implicit). Explicit strings directly state the relationship using clear relationship verbs, while implicit strings demonstrate active engagement through actions, coordination, or possessive language.

为了确保隐式字符串中的词汇多样性，我们将它们组织成代表工作场所行为不同方面的主题子类别。To ensure lexical diversity within implicit strings, we organize them into thematic subcategories that represent different aspects of workplace behavior.

例如，For example, the成员memberOf关系包括隐式子类别，例如用于新成员学习过程的“onboarding_to_team”、用于持续协调的“syncing_with_team_members”以及用于离开团队的成员的“knowledge_transfer_to_team”。 的relationship includes implicit subcategories such as "onboarding_to_team" for new members learning processes, "syncing_with_team_members" for ongoing coordination, and "knowledge_transfer_to_team" for members departing the team. The成员memberOf每个时间阶段包含 20 个显式字符串和每个时间阶段 140 个隐式字符串（7 个子类别，每个子类别 20 个字符串），总共 480 个字符串。 类似的分布也适用于其他关系类型，导致所有六种关系类型中总共有 3,217 个证据字符串变化。relationship contains 20 explicit strings per temporal stage and 140 implicit strings (7 subcategories with 20 strings each) per temporal stage, totaling 480 strings. Similar distributions apply to other relationship types, resulting in 3,217 total evidence string variations across all six relationship types.

会议证据字符串。Meeting evidence strings.

这些证据字符串与非会议字符串的不同之处在于，它们关注任务和项目进展，而不是关系的形成或解除。These evidence strings differ from non-meeting strings by focusing on task and project progress rather than relationship formation or dissolution.

这些字符串按进度级别而不是时间阶段进行组织，有四个进度箱：0-25%、25-50%、50-75% 和 75-100%。 每个进度箱都包含直接说明完成百分比的显式字符串和组织成代表该工作阶段典型活动的主题子类别的隐式字符串。These strings are organized by progress level rather than temporal stage, with four progress bins: 0-25%, 25-50%, 50-75%, and 75-100%. Each progress bin contains both explicit strings that directly state completion percentage and implicit strings organized into thematic subcategories representing typical activities at that stage of work.

例如，0-25% 进度箱包括隐式子类别，例如用于收集需求的“initial_research”、用于启动计划的“project_kickoff”以及用于组建团队和材料的“resource_gathering”。 随着进展的进展，子类别会发生变化，以反映后期活动：50-75% 的容器包括“beta_testing”和“integration_work”，而 75-100% 的容器包括“final_review”、“deployment_prep”和“ending_activities”。For example, the 0-25% progress bin includes implicit subcategories such as "initial_research" for gathering requirements, "project_kickoff" for launching initiatives, and "resource_gathering" for assembling team and materials. As progress advances, the subcategories shift to reflect later-stage activities: the 50-75% bin includes "beta_testing" and "integration_work", while the 75-100% bin includes "final_review", "deployment_prep", and "closing_activities".

每个进度箱包含 20 个显式字符串和 120 个隐式字符串（6 个子类别，每个子类别 20 个字符串），总共 560 个字符串Each progress bin contains 20 explicit strings and 120 implicit strings (6 subcategories with 20 strings each), totaling 560 strings for the任务进度taskProgress证据类型。evidence type.

附录CAppendix C主题Topics

非会议主题。Non-meeting topics.

对于非会议文件，我们分配与业务或非业务运营相关的主题。 为了随着语料库的增长保持词汇多样性，我们通过创建不同深度的分层主题结构来按比例缩放主题数量，类似于中定义的场景种子方法For non-meeting documents, we assign topics related to either business or non-business operations. To maintain lexical diversity as the corpus grows, we scale the number of topics proportionally by creating hierarchical topic structures of varying depth, similar to the scenario-seeded approach defined in(Sun et al., 2024).

我们从广泛的顶级类别开始。 非商业主题始终使用三个主要类别：“食品”、“旅行”和“交通”。 业务主题因公司领域而异：例如，Streamvibe（媒体）使用“内容创建”、“生产和分发”和“受众参与”，而 Biocure（制药）使用“药物开发”、“药物审批”和“药品销售”，而 Pound（金融）使用“交易采购”、“尽职调查”和“价值创造”。We begin with broad top-level categories. Non-business topics consistently use three main categories: "Food", "Travel", and "Transportation". Business topics vary by company domain: for example, Streamvibe (media) uses "Content Creation", "Production and Distribution", and "Audience Engagement", while Biocure (pharmaceuticals) uses "Drug Development", "Drug Approval", and "Drug Sales", and Pound (finance) uses "Deal Sourcing", "Due Diligence", and "Value Creation".

层次结构深度取决于语料库大小。 Zenith 是我们最小的公司，不需要子类别 - 它的业务主题从一开始就是特定的（例如“API 安全标准”、“微服务架构模式”），其非业务主题也是如此（例如“家庭烹饪”、“度假计划”）。 对于 Streamvibe、Biocure 和 Pound 等较大的公司，我们使用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 将顶级类别递归扩展到更深的层次结构，根据需要创建两个、三个或四个级别的子类别。 我们手动审核每个生成的主题，以确保其在包含之前适合公司电子邮件内容。The hierarchy depth depends on corpus size. Zenith, our smallest company, requires no subcategories—its business topics are specific from the start (e.g., "API Security Standards", "Microservice Architecture Patterns"), as are its non-business topics (e.g., "Home Cooking", "Vacation Plans"). For larger companies like Streamvibe, Biocure, and Pound, we recursively expand top-level categories into deeper hierarchies using Claude Sonnet 4.5, creating subcategories at two, three, or four levels as needed. We manually review each generated topic to ensure it is appropriate for corporate email content before inclusion.

Table 9显示了我们大公司 Biocure 的主题分层示例。shows the hierarchical example of topics for Biocure, our large company.

最后，为了选择非会议主题，我们使用稀疏 alpha 浓度为 0.75 的狄利克雷主题分布来确定我们将主题用于特定文档的概率。 这些分布如图所示Finally, to select non-meeting topics, we use a Dirichlet topic distribution with a sparse alpha concentration of 0.75 to determine the probability at which we’d use a topic for a particular document. These distributions are illustrated inFigure 5。 生成后的实际主题分布如图所示. The actual topic distributions after generation are illustrated inFigure 6.

会议主题。Meeting topics.

会议文档需要采用不同的主题分配方法，因为它们的内容是由会议动态而不是一般业务运营决定的。 我们从单独的池中选择会议主题，并根据会议类型来反映典型的讨论模式。 例如，直接报告会议通常涵盖“员工绩效评估”，而高管会议则重点关注“公司战略和愿景调整”。Meeting documents require a different approach to topic assignment, as their content is shaped by meeting dynamics rather than general business operations. We select meeting topics from a separate pool, conditioned on meeting type to reflect typical discussion patterns. For example, direct report meetings commonly cover "Employee Performance Review", while executive meetings focus on "Company Strategy and Vision Alignment".

并非所有会议电子邮件都会收到主题分配。 空白日历邀请和类似的内容最少的电子邮件缺乏实质性讨论，因此被排除在主题分配以及我们的主题分类、主题 QA 和综合 QA 评估任务之外。Not all meeting emails receive topic assignments. Blank calendar invites and similar minimal-content emails lack substantive discussion and are therefore excluded from topic assignment and from our Topic Classification, Topic QA, and Integrated QA evaluation tasks.

Table 10列出我们使用的会议主题。lists the meeting topics that we use.

附录DAppendix D会议Meetings

我们根据员工的组织角色和关系模拟他们的会议。We simulate meetings for employees based on their organizational roles and relationships.Table 11定义了我们的模拟框架支持的六种会议类型。每种会议类型都有几个参数：参与者的描述、生成会议记录的概率、生成议程的概率、将日历事件留空（没有会议记录或议程）的概率、会议频率、指定的组织者以及会议证实的知识图谱关系。defines the six meeting types supported in our simulation framework. Each meeting type is characterized by several parameters: a description of the participants, the probability of generating meeting minutes, the probability of generating an agenda, the probability of leaving the calendar event empty (without minutes or agenda), the meeting frequency, the designated organizer, and the knowledge graph relationships that the meeting substantiates.

对于每种会议类型，我们从相关组织关系中确定参与者。例如，直接报告会议涉及员工及其经理，而团队会议则包括属于或领导特定团队的所有员工。会议根据指定的频率（每周、每两周或每月）进行安排，并根据中显示的概率生成相关的工件（会议纪要和议程）。For each meeting type, we determine participants from relevant organizational relationships. For example, direct report meetings involve an employee and their manager, while team meetings include all employees who belong to or lead a particular team. Meetings are scheduled according to their specified frequencies (weekly, biweekly, or monthly), and associated artifacts (meeting minutes and agendas) are generated based on the probabilities shown inTable 11。 “空卡尔”。列表示会议在没有任何随附文档的情况下出现在日历上的概率。. The "Empty Cal." column indicates the probability that a meeting appears on calendars without any accompanying documentation.

“证实”列指示每种会议类型证明或强化了哪些知识图关系。例如，直接报告会议证实任务进度、报告关系和工作分配，而执行会议则提供项目进度和员工头衔的证据。这确保会议生成与底层知识图结构一致的组织活动的真实痕迹。The "Substantiates" column indicates which knowledge graph relationships are evidenced or reinforced by each meeting type. For instance, direct report meetings substantiate task progress, reporting relationships, and work assignments, while executive meetings provide evidence of project progress and employee titles. This ensures that meetings generate realistic traces of organizational activity that align with the underlying knowledge graph structure.

此模拟过程导致每位员工平均每季度召开 6 次会议，具体会议次数根据其职位、团队成员、项目参与情况和报告关系而有所不同。This simulation process results in each employee having an average of 6 meetings per quarter, with individual counts varying based on their position, team membership, project involvement, and reporting relationships.

KB-Gold 的 ETL。ETL for KB-Gold.

为了将知识库文件中的事实提取到我们的代理可以访问的 postgres 数据库中，我们使用 StoryBeat KB API 来访问实体、关系和文档。To extract ground truth from knowledge base files into postgres databases accessible to our agent, we use the StoryBeat KB API to access entities, relationships, and documents.

提取物Extract: 我们使用 StoryBeat KB API 的实体、关系和文档接口从 .kb 文件中提取数据。 提取使用生成器函数以可配置的批次（默认：1000 个项目）处理数据，而不是将整个数据集加载到内存中。: We use the StoryBeat KB API’s entity, relationship, and document interfaces to extract data from .kb files. The extraction uses generator functions to process data in configurable batches (default: 1000 items) rather than loading entire datasets into memory.

变换Transform: 实体根据实体类型（公司、员工、部门等）从知识库属性映射到数据库列。每个实体类型都有特定的属性映射（例如，Employee 使用: Entities are mapped from KB properties to database columns based on entity type (Company, Employee, Department, etc.). Each entity type has specific property mappings (e.g., Employee uses有名字hasName对于名字，for name,有别名hasAlias对于别名）。 关系是通过其时间信息提取的（for aliases). Relationships are extracted with their temporal information (开始beginning, 结束end）并分类为“持续”或“有界”。 使用知识库文档 API 单独处理文档，其属性包括发件人/收件人信息、日期、主题和会议参考。 数组字段（别名、收件人列表）使用以下命令从字符串表示形式转换为 PostgreSQL 数组类型) and classified as "ongoing" or "bounded". Documents are processed separately using the KB documents API, with properties including sender/recipient information, dates, topics, and meeting references. Array fields (aliases, recipient lists) are converted from string representations to PostgreSQL array types usingast.literal_eval.

负载Load: 使用事务内的批量 INSERT 操作将数据加载到 PostgreSQL 中以确保一致性。 实体表使用 KB 实体 ID 作为主键（例如，: Data is loaded into PostgreSQL using batch INSERT operations within transactions for consistency. Entity tables use the KB entity ID as primary key (e.g.,员工_EMP-D44FE8C5employee_EMP-D44FE8C5）。 该管道支持多种模式（每个公司/知识库一个），模式名称是从 KB 文件名推断出来的。 重复检测用途). The pipeline supports multiple schemas (one per company/knowledge base), with schema names inferred from KB filenames. Duplicate detection uses对冲突无所作为ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING处理幂等加载。to handle idempotent loading.

RAG 的 ETL。ETL for RAG.

RAG 管道构建用于文档检索的向量嵌入。The RAG pipeline builds vector embeddings for document retrieval.

提取物Extract: 使用知识库文档 API 将文档从知识库文件导出到临时目录。: Documents are exported from KB files to a temporary directory using the KB documents API.

变换Transform: 文档内容被截断为 22,000 个字符（: Document content is truncated to 22,000 characters (≈\approx8,000 个令牌）用于嵌入生成以保持在模型限制内。嵌入是使用 OpenAI 的 text-embedding-3-small 模型（1536 维）和并行处理（默认 4 个工作线程）生成的。8,000 tokens) for embedding generation to stay within model limits. Embeddings are generated using OpenAI’s text-embedding-3-small model (1536 dimensions) with parallel processing (4 workers by default).

负载Load: 嵌入使用 pgvector 扩展和 HNSW 索引存储在 PostgreSQL 中，以实现高效的相似性搜索。 批量插入（每批 500 条记录）优化数据库写入性能。 检测并跳过重复文档以避免冗余 API 调用。 完整的文档内容（未截断）与嵌入一起存储以供检索。: Embeddings are stored in PostgreSQL using the pgvector extension with HNSW indexing for efficient similarity search. Batch inserts (500 records per batch) optimize database write performance. Duplicate documents are detected and skipped to avoid redundant API calls. Full document content (not truncated) is stored alongside embeddings for retrieval.

附录FAppendix F质量保证基准QA Benchmarks

在下一节中，我们概述了来自不同公司的三种 QA 数据集类型的示例问题。在每个示例中，我们都包含审查/分析所需的最少文档集，以便能够完全回答所提出的问题。可能有多个最小文档集来回答上述问题，我们选择其中一个。所选问题是数据集中所有问题的一小部分，旨在显示问题、答案和文档的多样性。许多问题需要分析许多文件（例如“英镑金融集团有限责任公司的员工是谁？”），但为了简洁起见，这些问题被省略。In the following section, we outline sample questions from three QA dataset types across the different companies they are generated from. In each example, we include the minimal set of documents required to review/analyze to be able to fully answer the presented question. There may be multiple minimal sets of documents to answer said questions, of which we select one. The selected questions are a small subset of all questions in the dataset and aim to show the diversity of questions, answers, and documents. Many questions require analyzing many documents (e.g. "Who are the employees of pound financial group llc?"), but these questions are omitted for the sake of conciseness.

对于每个问题，我们都会测量约束的数量，这表示代理为回答问题必须应用的文档或知识库上的过滤器数量。然而，这并不一定与问题难度相关，因为限制数低的问题由于其广泛的广度可能更难回答（参见上面段落中的示例）。For each question, we measure the number of constraints, which represents the number of filters on the documents or KB that an agent must apply to answer a question. However, this doesn’t necessarily correlate with question difficulty, because low constraint count questions may be more difficult to answer due to their expansive breadth (see example in paragraph above).

附录JAppendix JQA 数据集假设QA Dataset Assumptions

我们明确声明了用于创建 QA 的以下假设和细节，以确保清晰度和正确使用：We explicitly state the following assumptions and details we were using to create our QA ensure clarity and proper use:

  • •

    通过在底层知识库上执行手动验证的 SPARQL 查询来获得真实答案。此验证过程可确保无论实例化哪些模板变量，都会返回正确的答案。Ground truth answers are obtained through manually-verified SPARQL queries executed on the underlying knowledge base. This verification process ensures that the correct answers are returned regardless of which template variables are instantiated.

  • •

    所有请求列表的问题（例如，“X 的所有员工是谁？”）都会返回没有重复条目的结果。此重复数据删除在整个数据集中一致应用。All questions requesting lists (e.g., "Who are all the employees of X?") return results without duplicate entries. This deduplication is applied consistently across the dataset.

  • •

    问题专门针对常规电子邮件主题，并有意排除与会议相关的主题，因为这些主题构成具有不同结构属性的不同语义类别。Questions exclusively target regular email topics and intentionally exclude meeting-related topics, as these constitute distinct semantic categories with different structural properties.

  • •

    由于 Pound 知识库的规模，最小约束问题通常会产生非常大的答案集。例如，查询“谁是 Pound 的员工？”返回数千个姓名，可能超出典型的 LLM 上下文窗口限制。相比之下，具有额外约束的问题会产生更易于管理、更具体的答案集，更适合 LLM 代理处理。Due to the scale of the Pound knowledge base, minimally-constrained questions often yield extremely large answer sets. For example, the query "Who is an employee of Pound?" returns several thousand names, potentially exceeding typical LLM context window limits. In contrast, questions with additional constraints produce more manageable, specific answer sets that are better suited for LLM agent processing.

  • •

    答案键生成过程应用 SELECT DISTINCT 操作来从结果集中删除重复的名称。因此，基于计数的答案与返回的姓名列表的实际长度之间可能存在细微差异，因为重叠的姓名会合并为单个条目。The answer key generation process applies SELECT DISTINCT operations to remove duplicate names from result sets. Consequently, a minor discrepancy may exist between count-based answers and the actual length of returned name lists, as overlapping names are consolidated into single entries.

在本节中，我们以图表形式可视化 QA 的结果。In this section, we visualize the results we have for QA in graphs.Figure 7按模型显示 QA 结果shows the QA results by model andFigure 8按方法显示 QA 结果。shows the QA results by method.

附录MAppendix M知识库评估结果KB Evaluation Results

表Table12揭示了跨关系类型和模型的不同错误模式。对于非时间关系，Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite 对 WorksOn 表现出最高的高预测率 (69%)，而所有模型都对出席关系表现出严重的低估率 (FN 比率为 63–71%)。事实证明，时间关系提取更具挑战性：Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite 高估了 WorksOn 56%，而 Haiku 4.5 显示了对参加 (45%) 和组织 (25%) 的明显高估。在不同的时间背景下，出勤率预测不足仍然存在问题（所有模型的 FN 率为 50-54%）。这些模式表明，无论时间上下文如何，模型都难以处理基于事件的关系（参加、组织），而结构关系（worksOn、memberOf）很容易出现过度预测，尤其是对于 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite。 reportsTo 和 WorksAt 等核心关系的相对平衡的错误率（大多 < 10%）表明分层组织结构的模型性能更好。reveals distinct error patterns across relationship types and models. For non-temporal relationships, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite exhibits the highest over-prediction rate for worksOn (69%), while all models show substantial under-prediction of attend relationships (63–71% FN rates). Temporal relationship extraction proves more challenging: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite over-predicts worksOn at 56%, while Haiku 4.5 shows notable over-prediction of attend (45%) and organize (25%). Under-prediction of attend remains problematic across temporal contexts (50–54% FN rates for all models). These patterns suggest that models struggle with event-based relationships (attend, organize) regardless of temporal context, while structural relationships (worksOn, memberOf) are prone to over-prediction, particularly for Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite. The relatively balanced error rates for core relationships like reportsTo and worksAt (mostly < 10%) indicate better model performance for hierarchical organizational structures.

附录NAppendix N主题分类结果Topic Classification Results

表Table13展示跨模型和训练规模的主题分类性能。在 Biocure (L) 上，所有模型均实现了强大的零射击性能（F1：0.872–0.950），而在几次射击设置中的改进很小（50 次射击 F1：0.877–0.982）。 TF-IDF+LR 基线展示了清晰的数据扩展，通过 10K 个示例达到了 0.993 的 F1——与 LLM 零样本性能相当，但需要更多的训练数据。在 Pound (XL) 上，LLM 显示出中等的零样本性能（F1：0.357–0.531），并具有显着的少数样本改进（50 样本 F1：0.598–0.751）。数据丰富的基线在 10 万个示例中实现了卓越的性能（F1：0.983），优于所有法学硕士。presents topic classification performance across models and training sizes. On Biocure (L), all models achieve strong zero-shot performance (F1: 0.872–0.950), with minimal improvement in few-shot settings (50-shot F1: 0.877–0.982). The TF-IDF+LR baseline demonstrates clear data scaling, reaching F1 of 0.993 with 10K examples – comparable to LLM zero-shot performance but requiring substantially more training data. On Pound (XL), LLMs show moderate zero-shot performance (F1: 0.357–0.531) with notable few-shot improvements (50-shot F1: 0.598–0.751). The data-rich baseline achieves superior performance at 100K examples (F1: 0.983), outperforming all LLMs.

附录OAppendix O质量保证错误分析QA Error Analysis

总共，我们使用 2 种方法（RAG 和 KB）在 3 个 QA 设置中为 4 个公司的 5 个 LLM 模型运行了 250 个问题。因此，我们总共运行了 30,000 次模型。In total, we ran 250 questions across 5 LLM models for 4 companies in 3 QA settings with 2 methods (RAG and KB). Thus, we had 30,000 total model runs.Table 14显示了我们在每个设置（主题 QA、知识库 QA 和集成 QA）中遇到的每个模型的编程错误。shows the programmatic errors that we ran into for each model in each setting (Topic QA, KB QA, and Integrated QA).

我们的分析揭示了不同模型的错误率存在显着差异，其中 GPT-5.1 的故障率最高（247 个错误，占运行的 4.1%），Sonnet 4.5 显示出最稳健的性能（91 个错误，占运行的 3.0%）。所有模型的总错误数为 30,000 次运行中的 697 次，总体失败率为 2.3%。Our analysis reveals substantial variation in error rates across models, with GPT-5.1 experiencing the highest failure rate (247 errors, 4.1% of its runs) and Sonnet 4.5 showing the most robust performance (91 errors, 3.0% of its runs). The total error count across all models was 697 out of 30,000 runs, representing a 2.3% overall failure rate.

基于 KB 的查询产生的错误比基于 RAG 的查询多 4.7 倍（547 个错误与 150 个错误）。这种差异表明知识库集成引入了额外的故障模式，特别是与工具调用和输出验证相关的故障模式。知识库查询的复杂性（需要模型来导航结构化数据并执行多个工具调用）导致错误率升高。KB-based queries produced 4.7× more errors than RAG-based queries (547 vs. 150 errors). This disparity suggests that knowledge base integration introduces additional failure modes, particularly related to tool calling and output validation. The complexity of KB queries—which require models to navigate structured data and execute multiple tool calls— contributes to this elevated error rate.

错误率与查询复杂度（S→M→L→XL）表现出明显的正相关性。对于 KB 查询，XL 规模问题产生了 175 个错误，而 S 规模问题仅产生 107 个错误。这种模式对于上下文长度问题尤其明显：“提示太长”错误几乎只发生在 L 和 XL 比例尺上，占 72 个此类错误的比例。这表明，随着查询复杂性的增加，模型会难以应对上下文管理和多步骤推理。Error rates exhibit a clear positive correlation with query complexity (S→M→L→XL). For KB queries, XL-scale questions generated 175 errors compared to just 107 errors for S-scale questions. This pattern is particularly pronounced for context length issues: "Prompt too long" errors occur almost exclusively at L and XL scales, accounting for 72 such errors. This suggests that as queries grow in complexity, models struggle with context management and multi-step reasoning.

{% 端基封闭endblock %}

4. **时间性Temporality is 必填REQUIRED** - 必须must be 一one of: ‘开始start‘, ‘结束end‘, or ‘正在进行的ongoing‘ (从不never 空null)
